from pathlib import Path
import json, os, shutil, tempfile

base=Path("morsehgp3D_v8/audits").resolve()
root=base.parents[1]
result=dict(RECEIPT)
output=Path(OUTPUT).resolve()
if output.parent != base or output.exists():
    raise RuntimeError("alias.replay_output_create_only")
references={}
for name,item in result["references"].items():
    raw=(root/item["path"]).read_bytes()
    import hashlib
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=item["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("alias.reference_hash")
    references[name]=json.loads(raw)
original=references["original"]
integrated=references["integration"]
helpers={"__name__":"alias_helpers","__file__":str(base/"p0_owner_checks.py")}
exec(compile(original["runner"]["text"],"archived_owner_helpers","exec"),helpers)
pin,command,require=helpers["pin"],helpers["command"],helpers["require"]
digest=helpers["digest"]
require(digest(original["runner"]["text"].encode())==original["runner"]["sha256"],
        "alias.archived_runner_hash")
require(digest(result["gate"].encode())==result["gate_sha256"],"alias.gate_hash")
workspace=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".work_owner_alias_",dir=base))
result["status"]="failed"
result["runs"]=[]
source_paths={}
try:
    for name,item in integrated["sources"].items():
        text=item.get("text",original["sources"][name]["text"])
        require(digest(text.encode())==item["sha256"],"alias.source_reference")
        require(item["sha256"]==RECEIPT["sources"][name]["sha256"],"alias.source_pin")
        dst=workspace/"src"/name
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        dst.write_text(text)
        source_paths[name]=dst
    result["sources"]={name:pin(path) for name,path in source_paths.items()}
    (workspace/"gate.cpp").write_text(result["gate"])
    compiler=Path(shutil.which("g++") or "missing-g++").resolve()
    for mode,flags in [("o2",["-O2"]),("san",["-O1","-g0","-fsanitize=address,undefined",
                                         "-fno-omit-frame-pointer","-no-pie"])]:
        binary=workspace/("alias_"+mode)
        env=dict(os.environ,TMPDIR=str(workspace))
        if mode=="san":
            env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS="detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=1",
                       UBSAN_OPTIONS="halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1")
        run={"mode":mode}
        result["runs"].append(run)
        run["compile"]=command([str(compiler),"-std=c++20","-Wall","-Wextra","-Wpedantic",
            "-Werror",*flags,"-I",str(workspace/"src"),str(workspace/"gate.cpp"),
            str(workspace/"src/pipeline/local_credits.cpp"),"-o",str(binary)],30,env,compiler)
        require(run["compile"]["exit_code"]==0 and not run["compile"]["timed_out"],"alias.compile")
        run["execute"]=command([str(binary)],10,env,binary)
        require(run["execute"]["exit_code"]==0 and not run["execute"]["timed_out"]
                and run["execute"]["stderr"]=="","alias.execution")
        require(json.loads(run["execute"]["stdout"])=={
            "status":"observed_input_buffer_alias","same_buffer":True,
            "closed_special_members":4,"lost_q2_pairs":3},"alias.observation")
        for operation in ("compile","execute"):
            require(run[operation]["executable_before"]==run[operation]["executable_after"],
                    "alias.executable_changed")
    result["source_after"]={name:pin(path) for name,path in source_paths.items()}
    require(result["sources"]==result["source_after"],"alias.copied_sources_changed")
    result["status"]="observed_input_buffer_alias_o2_san"
    result["source_capture"]="copied source hashes checked before and after this replay"
except Exception as error:
    result["error"]=str(error)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(workspace)
    result["temporary_removed"]=not workspace.exists()
    with output.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(result,stream,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":result["status"],"receipt":str(output)}))
raise SystemExit(0 if result["status"]=="observed_input_buffer_alias_o2_san" else 1)
